title: Interface tracking with Microscale Topological Surgery for two-dimensional filament breakup
summary: We design and implement a Microscale Topological Surgery (MTS) algorithm to detect and enforce topological transitions in two-dimensional tracked interfaces. The method combines classical Lagrangian tracking with an intermittent topological processor that: (i) constructs Eulerian snapshots from which an interface family with microscale-resolved topology is extracted, (ii) infers adjacency topology between dual Lagrangian and Eulerian interface families, and (iii) performs interface surgery to stitch the two families together across microscale defect regions.
